Name: Wear the Rainbow - A Prismatic Clothing Mod
Author: RiverDragon323
Description:
[b]Overview[/b]
Happy pride everyone!
To celebrate the month of rainbows, make your wardrobe shimmer with prismatic energy by using this mod! Adds 51 prismatic versions of in-game clothes, and also modifies the tailoring recipe for prismatic clothes to NOT consume your prismatic shard. If you have one shard, you can tailor as many prismatic clothes as you want! Provided you have the cloth for it, of course.
[b]Features[/b]
Adds prismatic versions of the following clothing items
Pants:[list]
[*]Dress
[*]Simple Dress
[*]Baggy Pants
[*]Relaxed Fit Pants
[*]Tight Pants
[*]Pleated Skirt
[*]Shorts
[*]Relaxed Fit Shorts
[*]Skirt
[/list]Shirts:[list]
[*]80s Shirt
[*]Backpack Shirt
[*]Basic Overalls
[*]Basic Pullover
[*]Bikini
[*]Island Bikini
[*]Cardigan
[*]Collared Shirt
[*]Crop Tank Top
[*]Crop Top
[*]Dark Bandana Shirt
[*]Dark Highlight Shirt
[*]Dark Striped Shirt
[*]Flannel Shirt
[*]Globby Shirt
[*]Gold-Trimmed Shirt
[*]Heart Shirt
[*]High-Waisted Shirt (Both top and bottom versions)
[*]Island Bikini
[*]Letterman Jacket
[*]Neat Bow Shirt
[*]Necklace Shirt
[*]Sailor Shirt (Both collar and body versions)
[*]Shirt and Belt
[*]Shirt and Tie
[*]Shirt with Bow
[*]Silky Shirt
[*]Sleeveless Overalls
[*]Sports Shirt
[*]Star Shirt
[*]Strapped Top
[*]Striped Shirt
[*]Tank Top
[*]Tube Top
[*]Turtleneck
[*]White Dot Shirt
[/list][b]How to obtain[/b]
All the clothes in my mod can be obtained the same way as vanilla prismatic clothes. Simply use the sewing machine, add cloth, add a prismatic shard, and bada bing bada boom you've got a swanky, new, rainbow wardrobe.
[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have Content Patcher and SMAPI installed
[*]Extract the mod files into your Stardew mod folder, or download with your mod manager
[*]Launch and enjoy!
[/list][b]Compatibility[/b]
This mod is only compatible with Stardew 1.6 onward due to fundamental changes to the game code. If you have not updated to 1.6, you will not be able to use this mod- I'd highly recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9019]Prismatic Pride[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4719]Prismatic Skirts and Dresses[/url]﻿ instead.
There shouldn't be any compatibility issues with other mods, but if there are let me know and I'll see if I can fix it!
